title: SSC CGL 2025 Social Reform Movements — Quiz Set 1

questions.question:
Who gave the title 'Raja' to Raja Ram Mohan Roy?
राजा राम मोहन राय को 'राजा' की उपाधि किसने दी?
options: Lord William Bentinck / लॉर्ड विलियम बेंटिंक
Mughal Emperor Akbar II / मुगल सम्राट अकबर द्वितीय
Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah II / मुगल सम्राट बहादुर शाह द्वितीय
Governor General Dalhousie / गवर्नर जनरल डलहौजी
questions.answer: Mughal Emperor Akbar II / मुगल सम्राट अकबर द्वितीय
questions.solution: The title 'Raja' was conferred on Ram Mohan Roy by Mughal Emperor Akbar II. This is a frequently asked trap — students often confuse Akbar II with Bahadur Shah II.

questions.question:
Which newspaper was published in Persian by Raja Ram Mohan Roy?
राजा राम मोहन राय द्वारा फारसी में कौन-सा समाचार पत्र प्रकाशित किया गया था?
questions.solution: Mirat-ul-Akhbar (1822) was in Persian; Sambad Kaumudi (1821) was in Bengali. This language distinction is a classic SSC trap.

questions.question:
In which year was the Brahmo Samaj founded?
ब्रह्म समाज की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
questions.solution: Brahmo Samaj was founded in 1828 by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in Kolkata. 1814 is the year of Atmiya Sabha — a very common exam trap.

questions.question:
Who was the first Secretary of Brahmo Samaj?
ब्रह्म समाज के प्रथम सचिव कौन थे?
options: Keshab Chandra Sen / केशब चन्द्र सेन
Ananda Mohan Bose / आनंद मोहन बोस
questions.solution: Tarachand Chakravarti was the first Secretary of Brahmo Samaj. This is a lesser-known but repeatedly asked fact in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
Satyashodhak Samaj was founded in which year?
सत्यशोधक समाज की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई?
questions.solution: Satyashodhak Samaj was founded by Jyotirao Phule in 1873 in Maharashtra. 1875 is for Arya Samaj — a common confusion point.

questions.question:
The title 'Mahatma' was given to Jyotirao Phule by whom?
ज्योतिराव फुले को 'महात्मा' की उपाधि किसने दी?
options: Gopal Krishna Gokhale / गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले
questions.solution: V.K. Vandekar gave Jyotirao Phule the title 'Mahatma'. Often confused with Gandhi's title, which was given by Tagore. A must-know SSC fact.

questions.question:
Which organisation was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale in 1905?
गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले ने 1905 में कौन-सा संगठन स्थापित किया?
options: Social Service League / सोशल सर्विस लीग
Servants of India Society / सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसायटी
questions.answer: Servants of India Society / सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसायटी
questions.solution: Gokhale founded the Servants of India Society in 1905. He was also Mahatma Gandhi's political guru — both facts are asked together in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
What was the real name of Swami Vivekananda?
स्वामी विवेकानंद का वास्तविक नाम क्या था?
options: Narendra Nath Datta / नरेन्द्र नाथ दत्त
questions.answer: Narendra Nath Datta / नरेन्द्र नाथ दत्त
questions.solution: Vivekananda's real name was Narendra Nath Datta. Gadadhar Chattopadhyay was Ramakrishna's real name — a classic SSC exam swap trap.

questions.question:
In which year did Swami Vivekananda deliver the famous Chicago speech?
स्वामी विवेकानंद ने प्रसिद्ध शिकागो भाषण किस वरष दिया?
questions.solution: Vivekananda's Chicago speech at the Parliament of World's Religions was in 1893. The Ramakrishna Mission was founded in 1897 — these two dates are interchanged in tricky questions.

questions.question:
Ramakrishna Mission was founded at which location?
रामकृष्ण मिशन की स्थापना किस स्थान पर हुई?
options: Belur Math, near Kolkata / बेलूर मठ, कोलकाता के पास
questions.answer: Belur Math, near Kolkata / बेलूर मठ, कोलकाता के पास
questions.solution: Ramakrishna Mission (1897) is headquartered at Belur Math near Kolkata. Dakshineswar is where Ramakrishna Paramahamsa served as priest — a common confusion.

questions.question:
Theosophical Society was originally founded in which city?
थियोसोफिकल सोसायटी की मूल स्थापना किस शहर में हुई थी?
questions.solution: Founded in New York (1875) by Blavatsky and Olcott; HQ shifted to Adyar, Madras in 1882. SSC often asks the original location, expecting students to answer Adyar.

questions.question:
Who founded the Prarthana Samaj in 1867?
1867 में प्रार्थना समाज की स्थापना किसने की?
options: Keshab Chandra Sen / केशब चन्द्र सेन
Atmaram Pandurang and Keshab Chandra Sen / आत्माराम पांडुरंग और केशब चन्द्र सेन
questions.answer: Atmaram Pandurang and Keshab Chandra Sen / आत्माराम पांडुरंग और केशब चन्द्र सेन
questions.solution: Prarthana Samaj was co-founded by Atmaram Pandurang and Keshab Chandra Sen in Bombay (1867). M.G. Ranade joined later in 1870 and made it prominent.

questions.question:
Arya Samaj was founded in which city?
आर्य समाज की स्थापना किस शहर में हुई थी?
questions.solution: Arya Samaj was founded in Bombay (1875) but its HQ was later shifted to Lahore. SSC traps students by asking the HQ location instead of founding city.

questions.question:
What was the real name of Swami Dayananda Saraswati?
स्वामी दयानंद सरस्वती का वास्तविक नाम क्या था?
options: Narendra Nath Datta / नरेन्द्र नाथ दत्त
Shiv Narayan Agnihotri / शिव नारायण अग्निहोत्री
questions.solution: Dayananda Saraswati's real name was Mool Shankar. All three real names (Vivekananda, Dayananda, Ramakrishna) are frequently tested together in SSC.

questions.question:
Who is called the 'Martin Luther of India'?
'भारत का मार्टिन लूथर' किसे कहा जाता है?
options: Raja Ram Mohan Roy / राजा राम मोहन राय
Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar / ईश्वर चन्द्र विद्यासागर
questions.solution: Dayananda Saraswati is called the 'Martin Luther of India' for his reformist work in Hinduism. This comparative title is a high-frequency SSC CGL question.

questions.question:
The Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act was passed in which year?
हिन्दू विधवा पुनर्विवाह अधिनियम किस वर्ष पारित हुआ?
questions.solution: The Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act (1856) was Vidyasagar's greatest achievement. 1829 is when Sati was abolished — both are tested together.

questions.question:
Who was the political guru of Mahatma Gandhi?
महात्मा गांधी के राजनीतिक गुरु कौन थे?
options: Bal Gangadhar Tilak / बाल गंगाधर तिलक
Gopal Krishna Gokhale / गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले
questions.answer: Gopal Krishna Gokhale / गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले
questions.solution: Gokhale was Gandhi's political guru. The relationship between guru and disciple pairs (Ramakrishna-Vivekananda, Gokhale-Gandhi) is frequently tested in SSC.

questions.question:
Brahmo Samaj of India was founded by whom in 1866?
ब्रह्म समाज ऑफ इंडिया की स्थापना 1866 में किसने की?
options: Ananda Mohan Bose / आनंद मोहन बोस
Keshab Chandra Sen / केशब चन्द्र सेन
Raja Ram Mohan Roy / राजा राम मोहन राय
questions.answer: Keshab Chandra Sen / केशब चन्द्र सेन
questions.solution: Keshab Chandra Sen founded the Brahmo Samaj of India in 1866 after differences with Devendranath Tagore. Knowing all four Brahmo factions is crucial for SSC.

questions.question:
Where did Raja Ram Mohan Roy die?
राजा राम मोहन राय का निधन कहाँ हुआ?
questions.solution: Raja Ram Mohan Roy died in Bristol, England in 1833. SSC often puts 'London' as a trap since he visited London, but he died in Bristol.

questions.question:
Narayana Guru's famous slogan was related to which cause?
नारायण गुरु का प्रसिद्ध नारा किस कारण से संबंधित था?
options: One Caste, One Religion, One God / एक जाति, एक धर्म, एक ईश्वर
Go Back to the Vedas / वेदों की ओर लौटो
India for Indians / भारत भारतीयों के लिए
questions.answer: One Caste, One Religion, One God / एक जाति, एक धर्म, एक ईश्वर
questions.solution: 'One Caste, One Religion, One God for Man' was Narayana Guru's slogan against the caste system in Kerala. 'Go back to Vedas' belongs to Dayananda Saraswati.

questions.question:
Henry Vivian Derozio taught at which institution?
हेनरी विवियन डेरोज़ियो किस संस्था में पढ़ाते थे?
options: Presidency College, Calcutta / प्रेसीडेंसी कॉलेज, कलकत्ता
Sanskrit College, Kolkata / संस्कृत कॉलेज, कोलकाता
Hindu College, Kolkata / हिंदू कॉलेज, कोलकाता
Serampore College, Bengal / सेरामपुर कॉलेज, बंगाल
questions.answer: Hindu College, Kolkata / हिंदू कॉलेज, कोलकाता
questions.solution: Derozio taught at Hindu College, Kolkata and inspired the Young Bengal Movement. He died at age 22 of cholera — his age at death is also asked.

questions.question:
Self-Respect Movement was founded by whom?
स्वाभिमान आंदोलन की स्थापना किसने की?
options: E.V. Ramasamy Naicker (Periyar) / ई.वी. रामासामी नायकर (पेरियार)
questions.answer: E.V. Ramasamy Naicker (Periyar) / ई.वी. रामासामी नायकर (पेरियार)
questions.solution: Periyar (E.V. Ramasamy Naicker) founded the Self-Respect Movement in 1925 in Tamil Nadu. It is often confused with the Justice Movement (1917).

questions.question:
The book 'Satyarth Prakash' was written by whom?
'सत्यार्थ प्रकाश' पुस्तक किसने लिखी?
options: Raja Ram Mohan Roy / राजा राम मोहन राय
questions.solution: Satyarth Prakash was written in Hindi by Dayananda Saraswati. 'Gulamgiri' was written by Jyotiba Phule in Marathi. Both books and their authors are frequently swapped in SSC questions.

questions.question:
Savitribai Phule is known as India's first female ______.
सावित्रीबाई फुले को भारत की पहली महिला ______ के रूप में जाना जाता है।
questions.solution: Savitribai Phule is India's first female teacher. She opened the Native Female School in Pune. Her works 'Kavya Phule' and 'Bavan Kashi Subodh Ratnakar' are also asked.

questions.question:
Which of the following was founded first?
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पहले स्थापित हुआ था?
questions.solution: Atmiya Sabha (1814) was founded before Brahmo Samaj (1828), Prarthana Samaj (1867), and Arya Samaj (1875). Chronological order of these organisations is a core SSC topic.
